metadata.project: Agentic AI-Assisted ICU Mortality Risk Prediction from the First 48 Hours

best_performing_models.rationale: Highest discrimination (Test B AUROC 0.8651, Test C AUROC 0.8602), highest precision-recall AUC (Test B AUPRC 0.5416, Test C AUPRC 0.5496), and highest F1-score (0.5291 on Test B, 0.5364 on Test C).
best_performing_models.best_recall_sensitivity: Simple RNN (48h FF) at default threshold (0.7606), LSTM (48h FF) at optimal threshold (0.6637 on Test B)
best_performing_models.best_precision: XGBoost Baseline (48h FF) (0.4676 on Test B, 0.4786 on Test C)
best_performing_models.best_f1: XGBoost Baseline (48h FF) (0.5291 on Test B, 0.5364 on Test C)
best_performing_models.best_auroc: XGBoost Baseline (48h FF) (0.8651 on Test B, 0.8602 on Test C)
best_performing_models.best_auprc: XGBoost Baseline (48h FF) (0.5416 on Test B, 0.5496 on Test C)

data_leakage_audit.preprocessing_isolation: Zero future leakage, forward-fill medians learned on Train Set A only
